title: Research report omits the Table of Contents mandated by the domain-research skill's step-06 synthesis structure
evidence: Skill file .agents/skills/bmad-domain-research/domain-steps/step-06-research-synthesis.md prescribes: '- 📚 GENERATE COMPLETE DOCUMENT STRUCTURE with intro, TOC, and summary' and its Final Document Structure block lists '## Executive Summary' then '## Table of Contents' then '## 1. Research Introduction and Methodology'. The delivered report's heading sequence (grep '^#') goes '## Executive Summary' (line 359) directly to '## 1. Research Introduction and Methodology' (line 418); `grep -in "table of contents"` on the file returns no match.
detail: The briefing requires 'Follow the skill's activation exactly'. Step-06's prescribed final document structure includes a '## Table of Contents' section; the 659-line report has none. All ten mandated content sections are present, so impact is navigational only.
recommended_fix: Insert a '## Table of Contents' listing the ten numbered sections plus the Recommendation section between the Executive Summary and section 1.
